title: Google Maps Leads Searcher output
description: Business leads in the default dataset (Leads view), diagnostics view for failures, and run metrics in the key-value store.

leads.title: Business leads
leads.description: Scraped places with name, category, address, phone, website, rating, reviews and coordinates.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Per-query/per-place status including no-results and failed records.

metrics.title: Run metrics
metrics.description: Counters: places saved, ok/partial/failed, CAPTCHA blocks, charged events.
